regulatory_calendar.directed_hake_september_2024_2025: Closed period for the directed-fishing design
regulatory_calendar.source_audit: Retain counts without target filtering and distinguish regulatory period from export coverage.

scope.recorded_weekday_coverage: All 3132 candidate keys are recorded Tuesday through Friday. The sampling schedule is unverified. One record falls on a tested national holiday.

unit.export_ordinal_scope: One full mdb-export before filtering, excluding its header. Keep linkage private and record the reader version.
unit.caladas_policy: Retain N_CALADAS and NUMERO_LANCE_EX. Flag missing, conflicting or multiple caladas and preserve original grouping.

reported_quantity.rule: Retain a finite nonnegative value only from one explicit species row on a complete candidate key, with no conflicting positive weight under code 999.
reported_quantity.zero_policy: Explicit zero remains a reported quantity with unvalidated semantics. Code 999 and target omission leave the hake quantity unset.
reported_quantity.multiple_species_rows_policy: Quarantine multiple target rows for review of scope before summing.
reported_quantity.blank_species_policy: Retain blank-species rows and flag for review. If a key has only blank-species rows, keep the hake quantity unset and quarantine the key for catch-outcome evaluation.

anchors.position_rule: Treat southwest DDMMSS parsing as a diagnostic. Verified capture position and approved pilot geometry are prerequisites for pairing.
anchors.environmental_rule: Keep environmental data separate until anchors are validated. Carry source and coverage provenance, including L3 availability and the mixed-coast diagnostic.

recorded_calendar_day_sensitivity.same_recorded_departure_return_day: The 3122 tested keys preserve their recorded day after offsets of 0, +3 and +4 hours are applied jointly to departure and return. This is conditional on the tested clock hypotheses and capture falling within the recorded interval. Source timezone and capture anchor remain unverified.
recorded_calendar_day_sensitivity.different_recorded_departure_return_day: Retain both dates and flag for comparison.

coastal_support_sensitivity.report: Compare eligible matched coverage with and without mixed cells when support permits. Keep missing support visible.
coastal_support_sensitivity.mixed_weight_fraction: Record the fraction of actual spatial weight assigned to GLOBE mixed cells for each match. A single-cell match has fraction 0 or 1.
coastal_support_sensitivity.scope: Diagnostic provenance only. Pilot geometry and marine mask validation remain pending.

operation_start_fields.rule: Retain the generic and operation-start pairs separately. Quarantine disagreements from pairing. The start fields describe different maneuver phases by gear. Stratify any future pairing by gear and preserve phase provenance.

effort.escalation_status: Resolved by agreement on interpretation scope. HHMM remains a working hypothesis. Centésimas de hora and mixed records remain open pending source documentation.

publication: Aggregate diagnostics only. Keep source records and candidate linkage private.
